THE SESSION PAIR: THE ONLY FILLS THAT SAY A STATE
included, included, excluded; then the session’s state as a tag
The share is the row itself: shaded in the character’s colour from the left edge to its part of
the largest row. An action under a character is shaded the same way without a colour. A rate
under 85% is cut out in red, stronger as it falls to 60%, and reads the same on any shade.

tone, and the plain difference under it

so); then the mark that folds it to its heading, and Pop out.
